content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a base-layer solution that allows digital creators to build, host, and sell their products without relying on platforms like Stripe, Teachable, and Gumroad. This infrastructure is designed to be self-sovereign, meaning that once deployed, the creator owns and controls every aspect of their digital storefront, including payment processing, product delivery, and customer data. This approach provides a permanent structural alternative to the traditional platform-based model, which often comes with restrictions, fees, and risks of account suspension or closure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is built using a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This architecture allows creators to deploy a fully functional digital storefront in 48 hours, with automatic payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that simplifies the deployment process and provides 30-day support.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, Teachable, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators face unique challenges in selling digital products, including payment processing, product delivery, and customer data management. By providing a self-sovereign infrastructure, creators can build, host, and sell their products without relying on platforms or countries that may restrict their access or impose fees.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not just a workaround for platform restrictions, but a permanent structural alternative.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is composed of several key components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is designed to work seamlessly with the others, providing a scalable and secure infrastructure for digital product sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.

Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan? No, PayPal is not available in these countries, and a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. However, creators can use sovereign commerce infrastructure to host and sell digital products without relying on PayPal or other restricted platforms.
Using sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can deploy a fully functional digital storefront in 48 hours with automatic payment processing and instant product delivery.

For more information, check out the COREMERCH GitHub repository and the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) from the COREMERCH website. Configure Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages as your hosting platform. Set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Set up NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Test and deploy your digital storefront.
